theme: 끌어당김의 법칙에서 가장 강력한 끌개는 신념 체계

overview.topic: 🔎 끌어당김에서 가장 강력한 끌개인 신념 체계
overview.stance_reason: the most powerful attractor is our belief system
overview.structure_reason: 생각·시각화만으로 실현된다는 흔한 오류(The common flaw)를 지적하고 가장 강력한 끌개는 신념 체계임을 제시

key_grammar.source_sentence: Perhaps you have heard of the Law of Attraction, which states that 'like attracts like' and that by focusing on positive or negative thoughts, one can bring about positive or negative results.

explanation.text: 콤마 뒤의 which는 앞의 명사(the Law of Attraction)를 '그런데 그것은~'으로 보충 설명한다.
계속적 용법(콤마+관계사)에는 관계대명사 that을 쓸 수 없고 which를 쓴다.
제한적 용법처럼 '~하는 명사'로 앞에서 걸어 해석하지 말고, '명사, 그리고 그것은~'으로 뒤에서 이어 해석한다.
which states that ~ and that ~ 처럼 which의 동사 states가 두 개의 that 명사절을 목적어로 받는다.

key_grammar.example_analysis: 선행사 the Law of Attraction를 콤마 뒤 which가 계속적으로 부연하고, states의 목적어로 두 개의 that절이 병렬 연결된다.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: Perhaps you [[1|have heard]] of the Law of Attraction, [[2|that]] states [[3|that]] 'like attracts like' and that by [[4|focusing]] on positive or negative thoughts, one [[5|can]] bring about positive or negative results.
drills.fix: 콤마 뒤의 계속적 용법에는 관계대명사 that을 쓸 수 없다. that → which(원문). 나머지 네 곳은 원문 그대로 옳다.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: It is true [[that/what]] we attract at the level of our own vibration and [[that/which]] our thoughts and words [[are/is]] extremely magnetic.
drills.fix: 완전한 절을 이끄는 진주어·병렬 명사절은 that, 주어 our thoughts and words가 복수이므로 are.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
drills.answer: Consider what limiting beliefs you have that contradicts your desires and upgrade them to beliefs that are in line with what you want to attract.
drills.fix: 선행사 limiting beliefs는 복수이므로 관계대명사 that의 동사는 contradicts가 아니라 contradict(원문)이어야 한다.
options: ① It is true that we attract at the level of our own vibration and that our thoughts and words are extremely magnetic.
② But the most powerful attractor is our belief system.
③ Consider what limiting beliefs you have that contradicts your desires and upgrade them to beliefs that are in line with what you want to attract.
④ The common flaw in our understanding of this law is that we believe all we have to do is think about or visualize something to manifest it.
⑤ Perhaps you have heard of the Law of Attraction, which states that 'like attracts like' and that by focusing on positive or negative thoughts, one can bring about positive or negative results.

drills.question: 그는 새 스마트폰을 샀는데, 그것은 매우 비쌌다. (계속적 용법 which 사용)
drills.answer: He bought a new smartphone, which was very expensive.

drills.question: 그러나 가장 강력한 끌개는 우리의 신념 체계이다.
drills.answer: But the most powerful attractor is our belief system.
